<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex04012026-07-0808-43-58" status="unreviewed"> <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="6a4"/> de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">'chiMs</rs> na re bden pa 2 zhes bya ba ni <rs type="school">mu stegs grangs can pa</rs> yan cad la grags pas theg pa
            chen po thun mong ma yin pa'i brjod bya ma yin la | bden pa 4 zhes bya ba ni nang pa
            sangs rgyas pa kho na la grags pas thun mong ma yin pa <expan>yin no</expan> zhes 'chad kyang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bod bsgres po</rs> ltar na theg pa chen po thun mong ma yin pa las grags pa'i brjod bya'o || 
            'di la yang <rs type="school">seMs tsaM pa</rs>'i lugs kyi bden pa 2 gyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> dang | <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="6a5"/> <rs type="school">dbu' ma pa</rs>'i lugs kyi
            bden pa 2 gyi mtshan <expan>nyid do</expan> || 
            dang po ni <rs type="person">slob dpon shan ti ba</rs> na de 'khrul pa'i shes
            pa yul dang yul can du bcas pa ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa ste | 'khrul pa'i shes pa'i yul
            ni bag gyi bzod pas kun rzob || yul zhis ma khri ste zhes pa las drangs na sgrib par
            byed pas na kun rdza'o || ma 'khrul pa'i shes pa yul dang yul can du bcas pa ni don daM
            pa'i bden pa ste | yul ni chos nyid de bzhin <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="6a6"/> 'dod || | yul can mthong laM
            las pa'i ses kyang bden pa 2 gyis bos 'dzin pa tsaM las mtshan nyid ni ma yin te |
            tshogs pa <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> du 'god na myi srid la | kha yar ba mtshan nyid du 'god na phan tshun
            ma khyab pa'o || yang 'di nyid kyi nang pa'i rab dbye' nas kun nas rtog ba'i dmigs par
            gyur ba ni kun rdzob du yod pa yin la | rnaM par dag par 'byung ba'i dmigs pa ni don daM
            par yod pa'o || zhes ba de snga ma dang don bsdu'o || <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="6a7"/> yang <rs type="work">mdzod kyi
            'grel pa</rs> las <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">sngon gyi slob dpon rnaMs</rs> na re lo na ba'i shis pa'i yul du gyur ba ni kun
            rdzob kyi bden pa yin la || log pas 'das pa'i yes dang de'i rjes las thob pa'i sel gyi
            yul ni don daM pa'i bden pa yin zhes bshad snga ma dang don mthun par 'dod do || </seg></TEI>
